issues.detail: The Greek 'σφοδρα πολυς' (very great/many) modifies the crowd of priests, but the Vietnamese translation 'gia tăng nhiều lắm' (increased very much) incorrectly applies this modifier to the number of disciples instead.
The Greek 'σφοδρα πολυς τε οχλος των ιερεων' indicates that there was a 'very great crowd' of priests; the Vietnamese 'một đám đông' (a crowd) misses the intensity of 'σφοδρα' (very/greatly).
